
Usage:   deno deploy [root-path]
Version: 0.0.9909               

Description:

  Interact with Deno Deploy                                                                      
                                                                                                 
  Calling this subcommand without any further subcommands will                                   
  deploy your local directory to the specified application.                                      
                                                                                                 
  For non-interactive use (CI, AI agents), authenticate via the                                  
  DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN env var (or --token) and pass --json --non-interactive                       
  to every subcommand. The CLI then emits a single JSON object on stdout,                        
  a structured { error: { code, message, hint } } envelope on stderr,                            
  and a stable exit code (0 OK, 1 GENERIC, 2 USAGE, 3 AUTH, 4 NOT_FOUND,                         
  5 CONFLICT, 6 NETWORK). See https://docs.deno.com/runtime/reference/cli/deploy/#agent--ci-usage
  for the full reference.                                                                        

Options:

  -h, --help                       - Show this help.                                                                            
  -V, --version                    - Show the version number for this program.                                                  
  --token                <token>   - Auth token to use                                                                          
  --config               <config>  - Path for the config file                                                                   
  --ignore               <path>    - Ignore particular source files                                                             
  -q, --quiet                      - Suppress non-essential output                                                              
  -j, --json                       - Emit JSON on stdout instead of human-readable output                                       
  -y, --non-interactive            - Fail fast instead of prompting; values must be supplied via flags or env vars (alias: -y)  
  --org                  <name>    - The name of the organization                                                               
  --app                  <name>    - The name of the application                                                                
  --prod                           - Deploy directly to production                                                              
  --allow-node-modules             - Allow node_modules directory to be included when uploading                                 
  --no-wait                        - Skip waiting for the build to complete                                                     

Commands:

  create       [root-path]  - Create a new application. If none of the flags are specified, the flow will be run interactively.
  env                       - Modify environment variables                                                                     
  database                  - Manage databases                                                                                 
  apps                      - Manage applications                                                                              
  orgs                      - List organizations                                                                               
  deployments               - Manage deployments (revisions)                                                                   
  logs                      - Stream logs from an application                                                                  
  setup-aws    [contexts]   - Setup cloud connections for AWS                                                                  
  setup-gcp    [contexts]   - Setup cloud connections for GCP                                                                  
  switch                    - Switch between organizations and applications                                                    
  logout                    - Revoke the Deno Deploy token if one is present                                                   
  whoami                    - Verify the current Deno Deploy token and list reachable organizations                            
  sandbox                   - Interact with sandboxes                                                                          

Examples:

  Verify the active token                    whoami --json                                                                                            
  Deploy current directory non-interactively --json --non-interactive --org my-org --app my-app --prod                                                
  Create a static app from CI                create --json --non-interactive --org my-org --app my-app --source local --runtime-mode static           
                                             --static-dir dist --region us
